plan.name: Shahzeb Business Group
plan.summary: Shahzeb's plan for running the business group in ANUM: 12 agents, 24 skills, 8 department assistants, approval rules, knowledge folders, 30 saved commands and 25 automations. It starts small: the pilot turns on only Chief of Staff, Customer Care and Finance Controller.

weeks.title: Get the basics ready. Chief of Staff, Customer Care and Finance Controller only write drafts
Customer Care sends routine replies, once the reply templates are tested
Sales Pipeline and Proposal Consultant start
Fleet Planner and Tyre Analyst start
Marketing Studio and Product Support start
Knowledge Steward, Automation Guardian and the department assistants start. Test that a backup restores
Settle in and fix what came up

items.name: Runtime: Retry & Budget
items.reason: ANUM already retries safe reads on its own and never retries anything sent outside. Spending is capped by the workspace's monthly AI budget, which the plan sets.

items.name: Admin: Change Control
items.reason: Only an organization administrator can change access, policies or how long data is kept, and every change is logged. No agent has a tool to change them.

items.name: Business Owner
items.reason: A written role for the organization.
facts: Matches ANUM role: owner
What they can do: approval:decide, policy:manage, organization:manage, membership:manage, audit:read, audit:export
ANUM itself checks only the owner, member, viewer and organization administrator roles. This template writes down what the person is meant to do.

items.name: Governance Administrator
items.reason: A written role for the organization.
facts: Matches ANUM role: org_admin (no spending authority); the pilot's Technical Administrator
What they can do: organization_policy:manage, policy:read, audit:read
ANUM itself checks only the owner, member, viewer and organization administrator roles. This template writes down what the person is meant to do.
May approve: Technical test evidence or routine change completion, only when assigned.
May approve: No authority over refunds, payments, discounts, campaigns, contracts, customer-data exports or policy changes; never grants themself more access.

Must escalate: Credential exposure, suspected breach, cross-tenant data exposure, failed backup, an integration outage affecting orders or payments, an approval bypass, an audit-log gap, or any request to weaken role controls: escalate to the owner or org_admin.

items.name: Operations and Care
items.reason: A written role for the organization.
facts: Matches ANUM role: member
What they can do: task:create, task:run, work:manage, whatsapp:reply, email:act, commerce:operate
ANUM itself checks only the owner, member, viewer and organization administrator roles. This template writes down what the person is meant to do.
May approve: Refunds up to AED 250, only within a completed written policy and delegated authority; a person executes payment.
May approve: No general authority for discounts, price changes, campaigns, contracts or data exports unless separately documented.
Must escalate: Refunds above AED 250, disputes, suspected fraud, personal-data requests, legal or safety issues, policy exceptions, unverified authenticity and any missing policy field.

items.name: Finance Reviewer
items.reason: A written role for the organization.
facts: Matches ANUM role: member
What they can do: task:read, work:manage, commerce:read, approval:read
ANUM itself checks only the owner, member, viewer and organization administrator roles. This template writes down what the person is meant to do.
May approve: Confirm a reconciliation when amounts and evidence match, within assigned access.
May approve: Independent Finance review of new commitments above AED 5,000 before the owner approves. Never executes money movement or writes off variances.
Must escalate: Variance AED 25.01 to 250: notify Shahzeb the same day. Above AED 250 or suspected fraud: escalate to Shahzeb at once.
Must escalate: Any payment, transfer or purchase, disputed refund, unexplained variance or missing remittance evidence.

items.name: Invite people and set their roles
items.reason: In Members, invite the Operations and Care lead, the finance reviewer, the product maintainer and the fleet specialist as members, and the stakeholder as a viewer. Give your trusted technical admin the organization administrator role in Keycloak.

items.name: Name the delegated approvers
items.reason: In Governance > Approval rules, add the Operations/Care Lead to 'Refunds up to AED 250', the person you delegate quotes to on 'Standard quotes up to AED 5,000' and the Finance Reviewer to step 1 of 'Commitments above AED 5,000'. Until then owners approve them.

items.name: Turn on two-step sign-in for everyone
items.reason: Two-step sign-in is switched on in the sign-in service (Keycloak). This plan cannot do it for you.

items.name: Turn on the two-person rule
items.reason: Go to Approval policy and turn on the two-person rule once you have a second owner.

items.name: Connect integrations in the plan's order
items.reason: Connect them in this order: AI model, email and phone alerts, one mailbox per business, calendar, WhatsApp, online store, Zoom or Teams, tyre planning, speech, web search, marketing and social media, webhooks. Each one needs your own account and login.

items.name: Upload the knowledge documents
items.reason: Upload each business's documents into the knowledge folders. In the title or a note, write who owns it, its version, whether it is approved, when it starts and when to review it.

items.name: Connect the store, CRM and issue tracker to their automations
items.reason: Automations 8, 9, 10, 16 and 24 start when another system (the store, the CRM or the issue tracker) sends a message. Set that up in Automations > Triggers. Its secret is shown only once.

items.name: Test and turn on each automation
items.reason: Every automation starts turned off. Run it by hand, check the result, then turn on its schedule or trigger.

items.name: Choose routine WhatsApp templates
items.reason: In WhatsApp > Templates, choose which templates may send without asking. Test each one first.

items.name: Give agents more freedom one step at a time
items.reason: Agents start with little freedom. Give an agent more in its Settings only after its drafts have been checked.

items.name: Per-agent AI budget caps
items.reason: ANUM sets an AI budget per workspace and per organization, not per agent. The plan adds the agents' amounts together into one monthly budget for the workspace.

items.name: Budget alerts at 50, 75 and 90 percent
items.reason: ANUM warns at 80 percent and stops AI use at 100 percent, as the plan asks.

items.name: Banking, bank reconciliation and money movement
items.reason: ANUM cannot connect to a bank or move money. Cash on delivery is checked against store orders only.

items.name: Courier tracking and delivery proof
items.reason: ANUM is not connected to a courier. Delivery status comes from the online store only.

items.name: Departments as objects
items.reason: A department is only a label on agents and assistants. It has no members or rules of its own.

items.name: Automations that run as a chosen agent
items.reason: An automation runs as the person who owns it. Its instructions describe the agent's job, but it does not get that agent's tools or freedom.

items.name: Agents placed in each business workspace
items.reason: The plan is applied to the workspace you open it in. The business workspaces start empty; open one and apply the plan there if it needs its own agents.

items.name: Configurable Home priorities
items.reason: Home shows Today's Focus, approvals and activity in a fixed order. It never shows zero when data is missing.

items.name: Loop limit of 5 cycles and retry counts per agent
items.reason: ANUM sets how many times a task may retry or repeat. It cannot be changed per agent.

approval_thresholds.label: Internal reports and tasks
approval_thresholds.anum: Agents can read and make changes inside ANUM without asking, as far as each agent is allowed.

approval_thresholds.label: Routine support replies
approval_thresholds.anum: WhatsApp templates on the auto-send list go out on their own. Any other message asks first.

approval_thresholds.label: Payments, transfers, purchases
approval_thresholds.plan: Human approval for any amount; a human executes
approval_thresholds.anum: ANUM has no payment tool, so money never moves from ANUM; payment-kind tools always ask, and rule 'Payments and transfers' sends them to owners.

approval_thresholds.label: Refund up to AED 250
approval_thresholds.anum: Rule 'Refunds up to AED 250': the refund's AED amount (with the task's other refunds added) routes it to the approvers listed. It starts with owners only; add the Operations/Care Lead by name. They can never approve their own request.

approval_thresholds.label: Refund above AED 250 or disputed
approval_thresholds.anum: Rules 'Refunds above AED 250' and 'Disputed refunds' route to owners only. ANUM has no refund tool yet, so a person pays.

approval_thresholds.label: Goodwill discount up to AED 100 and 5%
approval_thresholds.anum: Rule 'Goodwill discounts': members or owners approve when the amount is at most AED 100 and at most 5% of the order value; anything else, or an unknown order value, goes to owners. ANUM has no discount tool yet.

approval_thresholds.label: Standard quote up to AED 5,000
approval_thresholds.anum: Rule 'Standard quotes up to AED 5,000' routes to the approvers you name (owners until then).

approval_thresholds.label: Quote above AED 5,000 or non-standard
approval_thresholds.anum: Rule 'Quotes above AED 5,000': owners only.

approval_thresholds.label: Financial commitment above AED 5,000
approval_thresholds.anum: Rule 'Commitments above AED 5,000': step 1 a member (name the Finance Reviewer), step 2 an owner, two different people in that order.

approval_thresholds.label: Contract or signature
approval_thresholds.anum: No signing tool exists, so only a person signs; rule 'Contracts' sends any contract action to owners.

approval_thresholds.label: Publish or change prices
approval_thresholds.anum: The approval rules for prices and for publishing send these to the owner.

approval_thresholds.label: Campaign or social publication
approval_thresholds.anum: The approval rule for publishing sends these to the owner.

approval_thresholds.label: New promotional outreach
approval_thresholds.anum: Free-text sends always ask, and every send checks the contact suppression list: an opted-out contact is never messaged.

approval_thresholds.label: Personal-data export or sharing
approval_thresholds.anum: Privacy export is per person; workspace audit export needs the owner; rule 'Data exports' sends any export tool to owners.

approval_thresholds.label: Delete records
approval_thresholds.anum: Deleting always asks first.

approval_thresholds.label: Access, policy or retention change
approval_thresholds.anum: Only an owner or organization administrator can do this, and it is logged.

approval_thresholds.label: Approval expiry 24 hours
approval_thresholds.anum: Approvals expire after 24 hours by default.

approval_thresholds.label: Payload change invalidates approval
approval_thresholds.anum: An approval only covers the exact content that was approved. If the content changes, it needs a new approval.

approval_thresholds.label: No self-approval
approval_thresholds.anum: Delegated approvers never approve their own request. For owners, turn on the two-person rule in Approval policy (needs two owners).

approval_thresholds.label: Bulk = more than 10 promotional recipients in 24 hours
approval_thresholds.anum: ANUM already asks before sending to more than 5 people, which is stricter.

approval_thresholds.label: Task estimated above AED 20
approval_thresholds.anum: ANUM cannot estimate a task's cost before it runs. The monthly budget stops AI use instead.

memory_rules.label: Owner preferences
memory_rules.anum: ANUM keeps remembered chat facts for one set time (90 days). It cannot keep different kinds for different times.

memory_rules.label: Brand tone
memory_rules.anum: Save it as a note in the 01 Business Facts folder. Notes stay until someone deletes them.

memory_rules.label: SOP references
memory_rules.anum: Keep notes and documents in the 02 SOPs folder.

memory_rules.label: Lead context
memory_rules.anum: Remembered chat facts are deleted after 90 days.

memory_rules.label: Active support context
memory_rules.anum: ANUM cannot keep something only for the length of a case.

memory_rules.label: Complaint summary
memory_rules.anum: The 90-day limit applies. ANUM has no separate restricted kind.

memory_rules.label: Financial context
memory_rules.anum: ANUM cannot keep different kinds for different times.

memory_rules.label: Meeting decisions
memory_rules.anum: Meeting notes stay drafts until a person confirms them.

memory_rules.label: Raw audio
memory_rules.anum: Voice recordings are deleted on their own schedule.

memory_rules.label: Temporary execution context
memory_rules.anum: Saved progress of a running task is not kept as memory.

memory_rules.label: Opt-out suppression
memory_rules.anum: Opt-outs are kept on the contact suppression list until a person removes them, and every send checks it.

memory_rules.label: Never: passwords, tokens, recovery codes, card details, unnecessary IDs, unrelated family or health data
memory_rules.anum: Secrets are hidden in approvals and logs, and agents are told never to save them.
